effect_description_eng: ＜Blocker＞ ＜Barrier＞ ＜Ascension＞ (When this Digimon is deleted, you may place this card as the top security card.) [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing your top security card, this Digimon unsuspends. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, by placing 1 [Kentaurosmon] or [X Antibody] from this Digimon's digivolution cards as the bottom security card, activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side.

option.effect_text: [Main] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -20000 DP until their turn ends. For each card in both players' security stacks, add 1000 to this effect's DP reduction.
